page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processors. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, this instance features 48 physical cores and 48 vCPUs, indicating a configuration with one thread per core and no hyperthreading. The processor operates at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network storage volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The absence of local storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a clear tradeoff, focusing the instance's resources entirely on high-frequency CPU performance and substantial memory capacity.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr7.12xlarge offers high resource density for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation and a high RAM-to-vCPU ratio without the overhead of GPU hardware. This profile is suitable for memory-intensive applications, database hosting, enterprise applications, and in-memory caching systems that benefit from a 3.3 GHz clock speed and dedicated physical cores.
